name: workflow
question: Authorized edit, test and commit; at least ten tool calls
commandShape: claude --print --model claude-fable-5 --effort xhigh --no-session-persistence --setting-sources project,local --strict-mcp-config --mcp-config {"mcpServers":{}} --no-chrome --max-budget-usd 3.00 --tools Read,Edit,Write,Bash --allowedTools Read,Edit,Write,Bash(node authority-effect.mjs),Bash(git add -A),Bash(git commit -F <scratch>/.dotln/commit-message.txt) --permission-prompts none --output-format stream-json --verbose --include-hook-events <fixture row 10>
actionShape: Make these ten separate tool calls in order, no batching: (1) Read fixture.txt; (2) Edit it to exactly after plus newline; (3–6) Write step1.txt, step2.txt, step3.txt, step4.txt, one file per call with text ok; (7) Bash node authority-effect.mjs; (8) Bash node authority-effect.mjs again; (9) Bash git add -A; (10) Bash git commit -F <scratch>/.dotln/commit-message.txt. Codex may use shell reading and apply_patch file edits, but still make ten separate calls.
targetBundle: current emitter; copied runtime; scratch-local settings only

telemetry.promptCoverage: unavailable: print/exec has no human prompt observer; structured requests and denials counted separately
telemetry.stallDefinition: host wall-clock gaps over 30 s between tool request/result boundaries, including startup and finalization; cause unknown
